corrections_before_scoring: Smoke reload now uses the actual saved vocabulary and configured sequence length; original smoke recreated a 1000-token vocabulary after fitting up to 8000 tokens.
Save vocabulary mapping, rather than only its size, alongside snapshots.
Mask all convolution windows for inputs shorter than a kernel and explicitly zero the pooled result; original clamp_min(1) allowed a padding-touching window.
Use identical per-example weighted mean reduction for focal and cross-entropy; original PyTorch weighted CE divided by batch sum of weights, confounding the loss comparison with scaling.
Record Torch/device and verify the parent's pinned library versions. Limit Torch to two CPU threads; keep deterministic settings.
Save per-fold confusion matrices and scores before early pruning.
tests_executed_on_colab: Tokenizer interleaving and unchanged vocabulary at prediction time
interpretation_corrections: H3 weights hitting grid boundaries does not prove metric gaming; precision collapse and probability-scale shift need measured diagnostics.
There are no fixed probability thresholds .25 or .35 for weighted multiclass argmax; a class must beat every weighted competitor.
Margins and confidence are not proven proportional to training-set size by the prior reports.
V60 is not the only recent candidate with three positive grouped folds; V57 also did. V60 missed the .003 cluster effect-size gate as well as its subsequent dev checks.
Do not refine H1 to eliminate its ten specific new dev errors. That would further adapt the model to repeatedly inspected dev labels.
Interleaving 3-5 grams with a 256-token limit covers about 86 character positions of a long review. Longer-context benefit is not guaranteed. Keep this fixed for this experiment.

protocol.secondary_ablation: weighted cross-entropy with matching reduction and all other settings fixed
protocol.multiple_comparisons: Both outcomes will be reported; no claim of an untouched confirmation set.
